name: 松叶羊
evolution: 松仔 → 松叶羊 Lv.16 → 针叶巡林 Lv.36
description: 刚刚经历换角，松果模样的角脱落，身上的针叶变得锋利，逐渐觉醒领地意识。换角的过程中不要贸然靠近，不然会被踢出几米远。被踢的时候可以闻到它们身上带着森林中泥土和青草的香味。
descriptionEn: Having just molted, the pinecone-like horns fall off and the needles on its body become sharp, gradually awakening territorial awareness. Don't approach rashly during the molt or you'll be kicked several meters away. When kicked, you can smell the forest's earth and grass scent on them.
